Notes: Native account 000000000000 is mapped to 123456789012; original actor is IAM user Delegated, not root. Other-account reads are derived local isolation checks, not a native second-account capture.

Evidence files retain bounded native observations, publication gaps, and cleanup. Absent native datapoints are never converted into zero. RTC and NotTracked are intentionally excluded; no native fifteen-minute RTC capture exists.

Each phase freezes service time. Explicit Drain boundaries expose pending work at a minute boundary, then finish before the next minute. Native wall-clock request-to-event latency and metric publication delay are not replay timing contracts.

Failure record equality binds the original Put sequencer, source version and eventTime as requestTime. Failure service principal/sourceIPAddress, eventVersion 2.6, rule, destination ARN and s3Operation remain measured literal values.

Source tag-read and destination tag-write denials are bounded native FAILED source / readable untagged REPLICA observations with no failure receipt and a processed-operation zero-failure counter sample, not universal suppression rules.

The supplied captures have no direct EventBridge sink or CloudTrail trail. EventBridge-to-SQS is a local routing extension with positive Object Created control and no replication-specific event; no native internal CloudTrail event shape is fabricated.

Regional gauges are observed in destination region under source account; failure statistics are observed in source region. Mixed native point has Minimum=Maximum=Sum=1, SampleCount=4, Average=0.25: extrema must not be clamped around the average.

Signals body bytes are recovered from DownloadedBody[35]; regional bytes from DownloadedBody[35,39,55,73]. Semantic projections select observed operation outcomes; generated IDs and timestamps are rebound.
